+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                   | **Paracetamol**                                                          | **Aspirin**                                                                                  |
+===================+==========================================================================+==============================================================================================+
| Pathophysiology   | - Saturated glucuronidation, sulfation                                   | - Uncoupled oxidative phosphorylation → ↑VO~2~ and VCO~2~ → metabolic acidosis, hyperthermia |
|                   | - ↑NAPQI → glutathione exhaustion → cell damage                          | - Resp depression in children                                                                |
|                   | - Centrilobular necrosis                                                 | - Resp alkalosis in adults                                                                   |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Risk factors      | - Malnutrition                                                           | - Children                                                                                   |
|                   | - Liver disease                                                          |                                                                                              |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Complications     | - Fulminant liver failure                                                | - Seizure                                                                                    |
|                   | - Coagulopathy                                                           | - Cerebral oedema                                                                            |
|                   | - Hypoglycaemia                                                          | - Cardiac arrest                                                                             |
|                   | - Death                                                                  |                                                                                              |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Toxic dose        | - 200mg/kg or 10g, whichever is less                                     | - 150-300mg/kg: mild-mod                                                                     |
|                   |                                                                          | - \>300mg/kg: severe                                                                         |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Toxic thing       | - NAPQI                                                                  | - Aspirin                                                                                    |
|                   |                                                                          | - Salicylic acid                                                                             |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Toxin elimination | - Hepatic metabolism                                                     | - Hepatic metabolism                                                                         |
|                   |                                                                          | - Renal excretion                                                                            |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Symptoms          | - Abdo pain, vomiting                                                    | - Nausea, tinnitus, dizziness, blurred vision                                                |
|                   | - Later: jaundice                                                        |                                                                                              |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Treatment         | - N-acetyl cysteine                                                      | - Forced alkaline diuresis e.g. HCO~3~^-^ → traps metabolite in urine                        |
|                   | - Dosing using nomogram                                                  | - Haemodialysis                                                                              |
|                   | - Activated charcoal for adsorption if recent ingestion (e.g. \<2 hours) | - Activated charcoal for adsorption if recent ingestion (e.g. \<2 hours)                     |
|                   | - Supportive                                                             | - Supportive                                                                                 |
|                   | - +/- Liver transplantation                                              |                                                                                              |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
